web-client.rationale: Copilot in the cloud starts from GitHub.com; GitHub Mobile is also an entry point. Scope: GitHub Copilot app, GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Copilot IDE agent mode, GitHub Mobile.

cli.rationale: The CLI supports Linux, macOS and Windows through PowerShell or WSL. Scope: GitHub Copilot app, GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Copilot IDE agent mode, GitHub Mobile.

local.rationale: Default project tasks run against the local machine; --cloud selects GitHub-hosted compute instead. Scope: GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Mobile.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Cloud sandboxes and Actions-based sessions execute remotely; Actions can use configured self-hosted runners. Scope: GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Mobile.

own-server.rationale: Copilot sessions can use a registered user-managed Linux environment.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Repository automations run tasks on schedules in eligible private/internal repositories. Scope: GitHub Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Mobile.

pr-workflow.rationale: Both Actions-based and cloud-sandbox sessions work on one branch and can open one PR per task. Scope: GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Mobile.

free-tier.rationale: Free has limited features and an AI-credit allowance; the plans page says all plans include CLI and the Copilot app. Scope: GitHub Copilot app, GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Copilot IDE agent mode, GitHub Mobile.

starting-price.rationale: Free has limited features and an AI-credit allowance; the plans page says all plans include CLI and the Copilot app. Scope: GitHub Copilot app, GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Copilot IDE agent mode, GitHub Mobile.

macos.rationale: Product-owned Copilot desktop app explicitly supports this OS.

windows.rationale: Product-owned Copilot desktop app explicitly supports this OS.

linux.rationale: Product-owned Copilot desktop app explicitly supports this OS.

ios.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a native iOS application with Copilot features.

android.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a native Android application with Copilot features.

mobile-web.rationale: The connectors documentation explicitly names Copilot in the cloud in a mobile browser.

claude-code.rationale: Public-preview GitHub Claude coding agent uses Claude Agent SDK; paid Copilot and partner policy required.

codex.rationale: Public-preview GitHub Codex coding agent uses Codex SDK; paid Copilot and partner policy required.

cursor.rationale: The complete supported third-party coding-agent list contains Claude and Codex only; it omits this harness. Model names are not harness integrations.

byo-subscription.rationale: Existing Copilot subscription can power the documented partner coding-agent SDK integrations.

review.note: The finding says partner Claude and Codex agents run on the existing Copilot subscription and explicitly does not establish use of separate Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions. Reusing the ADE's own plan is not the BYO coding-agent subscription this filter describes.

worktree.rationale: The Copilot app creates per-session Git worktrees.

vm.rationale: GitHub-hosted Actions runners give cloud-agent sessions fresh VMs; this does not describe the separate cloud-sandbox implementation.

parallel-runs.rationale: The app explicitly runs multiple concurrent agent sessions.

coordinator.rationale: /fleet makes the product-owned main agent delegate, manage dependencies and combine child results.

roles.rationale: The cited agent-management page, rechecked 2026-11-21, now describes the Copilot in the cloud policy and enterprise and organization owners but no longer names AI managers or role permissions as the earlier finding recorded. Unknown until TEAM-02 organization_roles is rechecked against a current source.

sso.rationale: CLI OAuth supports organization SAML authorization.

review-ui.rationale: Copilot app supports in-product code-change and PR review.

license.rationale: Main Copilot use is governed by plan/purchase-specific custom service terms.

self-hosting.rationale: The core CLI harness runs without GitHub services in offline BYOK mode; local model needed for full airgap.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Offline CLI mode explicitly fully disables telemetry; applies to CLI, not hosted UI.

laptop-independent.rationale: A cloud sandbox requires no connected client while work runs.

free-plan.rationale: Plan table separates free access from paid plans.

per-seat.rationale: Business $19 and Enterprise $39 per granted seat.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete plan table lists recurring individual and seat plans, and no no-paid-plan pricing option.

one-time.rationale: The complete plan table lists recurring individual and seat plans, and no one-time pricing option.

usage-based.rationale: Cloud-sandbox runtime resources have metered charges after the shared included allowance.

compute.rationale: Cloud-sandbox runtime resources have metered charges after the shared included allowance.

byok.rationale: Copilot CLI accepts a model provider API key without requiring GitHub authentication.

paid-from.rationale: Pro $10/month. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

issue-tracking.rationale: Copilot creates and edits persistent GitHub-owned issue records with labels and assignees through its draft workbench. These records exist before dispatch and are not session-list entries.

multiplayer.rationale: People with repository write access can each prompt Copilot on the same PR. This does not claim simultaneous local-session co-steering.
